d: Short, choppy lavender hair with thick bangs and flared ends frames a youthful, adolescent face with large, round reddish-orange eyes. A petite build is dressed in a white sailor-style top with a teal collar, a dark red necktie, and a matching white skirt with a teal waistband. The figure is equipped with grey metallic naval artillery gear, including a turret mounted on the shoulder and a structural hull piece behind the back.
